description:
Markdown editor with live preview

Orden is a small markdown editor that formats what you write as you write it.
There is no split screen and no preview pane: headings, emphasis, lists, tables,
code and math take their final shape in the same window you type in, and the
markdown underneath stays plain text you can open anywhere. Notes are plain .md
files in folders on disk, they sync across devices, and the same editor runs in
a browser at orden.so.
